description: This file defines a singleton class 'TeamManager' for managing NVSHMEM teams in a distributed CUDA environment, including methods for retrieving and allocating teams, and handling device memory.

classes.name: TeamManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing NVSHMEM teams, including creation, retrieval, and cleanup of team resources in a distributed CUDA environment.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TeamManager for a given device, ensuring only one manager per device.

methods.name: get_team
methods.description: Retrieves a team for a specified group name and global ranks.

methods.name: get_n_teams
methods.description: Retrieves multiple teams for a group, managing device memory and synchronization.

methods.name: group_to_team_pool
methods.description: Internal method to create or retrieve a pool of teams for a group, creating new teams if necessary.
